subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 10/11] mountd: bound the retry queues

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch limits the size of three retry queues in the mountd service to prevent them from growing indefinitely. The queues are used when the server cannot immediately determine whether a client's filehandle is exportable, and they can be reached by clients through network requests. By capping these queues at MAX_DELAYED (1024 entries), the patch prevents excessive memory usage and latency caused by repeated deferrals. The cap only applies to new queue entries, allowing existing records to be re-queued without being dropped.
